claim: C2C12 cells are labelled with superparamagnetic nanoparticles without altering their biological capacities.
source: C2C12 cells are labelled with superparamagnetic nanoparticles without altering their biological capacities (Van de Walle et al., 2020a; Van de Walle et al., 2020b) nor inducing hypoxia or apoptosis (Figure 1—figure supplements 1 and 2).
evidence: Supported by citations to Van de Walle et al., 2020a and 2020b, and by data shown in Figure 1—figure supplements 1 and 2.

claim: Magnetic labelling of C2C12 cells does not induce hypoxia or apoptosis.

claim: Surface tension and magnetic forces in volume compete to determine the equilibrium shape of multicellular aggregates.
